title: Reproductive Health
seo_title: Reproductive Health Class 12 Biology Worksheet with Answers (NCERT Chapter 3)
standard_text: Need for reproductive health and prevention of Sexually Transmitted Diseases (STDs); birth control – need and methods, contraception and medical termination of pregnancy (MTP); amniocentesis; infertility and assisted reproductive technologies – IVF, ZIFT, GIFT (elementary idea for general awareness).
meta_desc: Free CBSE Class 12 Biology worksheets for NCERT Chapter 3 Reproductive Health: reproductive health programmes, contraceptive methods, MTP, sexually transmitted infections, infertility and assisted reproductive technologies. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Reproductive health means physical, emotional, social and behavioural well-being.
key_sub: Contraceptives can be natural, barrier, IUD, hormonal or surgical.
body_html:
How to think about it

Reproductive health covers all aspects of reproduction: physical, emotional, behavioural and social well-being. India's RCH programmes spread awareness about safe practices, family planning and preventing sexually transmitted infections (STIs), many of which can be prevented by safe practices and treated if found early.

Contraceptive methods include natural methods, barriers (condoms, diaphragms), IUDs such as Copper T, hormonal pills and surgical methods (vasectomy, tubectomy). Infertile couples can be helped by assisted reproductive technologies such as IVF, ZIFT, GIFT, ICSI and artificial insemination.

Example

Copper T is a?

placed in the uterus

Answer: intra-uterine device

Example

Embryo up to 8 cells into oviduct?

zygote transfer

Answer: ZIFT

Common mistakes

  • Thinking all STIs are curable.
  • Calling vasectomy a temporary method.
  • Mixing up ZIFT and GIFT.
